latest.title: Kyntex Band 1.6.3
latest.notes: Requires Kyntex iOS 2.4.3 or later. Workout start and calibration now use the same 1,500-count FSR fit threshold. Workouts start after 1.5 seconds at or above the threshold and end after 3 seconds below it. Fixes repeated workout starts when the band is tight at power-on and improves sensor wake and workout recovery. End your workout and charge the band to at least 40% before installing.
